responsibility: Declares the core gccrs parser interface and parser-side helper types for converting Rust token streams into the Rust AST. It defines `ExprOrStmt` and `ParseRestrictions` for handling grammar ambiguities, declares the templated `Parser<ManagedTokenSource>` class with entry points for crate, item, statement, expression, pattern, type, attribute, token-tree, and macro parsing, manages parser error storage and inline module context, and exposes standalone helpers for module-path extraction and macro-match compatibility checks; the matching template definitions are pulled in from `rust-parse-impl.h`.
same_name_distinction: This is the parser API/type-definition half of the `rust-parse` pair: it declares `ExprOrStmt`, `ParseRestrictions`, the templated `Parser<ManagedTokenSource>` interface, and the helper function prototypes, then includes `rust-parse-impl.h` for template definitions. The same-stem `.cc` file is instead limited to non-template helper implementations such as module-path extraction and macro-match compatibility checks.
